recentItems.title: Why have so many U.S. hockey players demanded to leave Canada? | Hanomansing Tonight
recentItems.description:
The Winnipeg Jets have suspended the goaltender Connor Hellebuyck for failing to report to training camp. The goalie publicly requested a trade out of Winnipeg this off-season — the latest in a group of U.S. players who have requested trades from their Canadian teams. Despite that, former NHL player Georges Laraque tells Hanomansing Tonight he wouldn't put every American player on a Canadian team in the same basket.

recentItems.title: Rise of young men in ER following online gambling expansion
recentItems.description:
Researchers in Ontario have found a drastic increase in emergency department visits in recent years following the legalization of single sports betting and the rapid growth of online gambling in the province. Boys and men ages 10 to 44 are the most affected group. Currently, there are over 80 gaming and betting sites operated by more than 40 companies in Ontario.
